description: HTTP security headers audit of a website with a grade. Fetches the page and grades its security headers A to F: HSTS, Content-Security-Policy, clickjacking protection, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, plus cookie flags and server banner leaks. Each check has the header value and what to fix. Use for a quick security review of a site. Price $0.020 per call (x402: USDC on Base or Solana).
